title: EN 50160 supply voltage variation
statistic: standard: 95 % of 10-minute mean r.m.s. values within +/-10 % over a week; M4 applies the band to each hourly solved state
source: EN 50160, Voltage characteristics of electricity supplied by public distribution networks
note: An hourly state is a coarser average than the standard's 10-minute means, so this is a proxy, not a compliance claim.
